tool_args.rationale: The observations show strong, non-separable variation with both current input and sink gradient, while all other supplied variables are fixed. Fit a low-order smooth interaction surface numerically to the available rows; no evidence invokes high-gradient avalanche behavior.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: No observed s_grad exceeds 2.36, so the cited supercritical-avalanche regime is not engaged by these samples.
Nine observations already span the sampled u_now and s_grad ranges; a flexible smooth interaction model can be fitted without another paid probe.
It depends only on u_now and cannot explain the pronounced y variation across s_grad at comparable u_now.
The observed gradient response is not consistently monotone across u_now, making a simple multiplicative power law inadequate.
